category_title: Students with severe intellectual disability (SID) using pre-symbolic or limited symbolic communication and idiosyncratic repair strategies
minimal_context: The student is participating in a daily routine classroom activity and attempting to communicate a want during snack time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our morning snack routine. Here is your empty cup.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes eye contact, uses facial expressions, and makes sounds while approaching the tutor to sign her wants for the juice pitcher.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just sit down in your chair.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Changes posture, shouts, and approaches the pitcher again, using idiosyncratic behaviors to communicate her intent.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the cup on your table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Withdraws completely from the table, drops eye contact, and terminates all communication attempts, resulting in complete communication arrest.)

dialogue_combined:

STUDENT: (Makes eye contact, uses facial expressions, and makes sounds while approaching the tutor to sign her wants for the juice pitcher.)

TUTOR: Just sit down in your chair.

TUTOR: Look at the cup on your table.

STUDENT: (Withdraws completely from the table, drops eye contact, and terminates all communication attempts, resulting in complete communication arrest.)
